package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestAssessmentAnswerKeysAreRedactedFromPublicResponse(t *testing.T) {
	correctOrder := 2
	tests := []domain.TaskTest{{
		ID:        "question-id",
		SourceKey: "question-key",
		TaskID:    "task-id",
		Kind:      domain.TaskTestKindOrdering,
		Order:     1,
		Groups: []domain.TaskTestGroup{{
			ID: "group-id", SourceKey: "group-key", TaskTestID: "question-id", Title: "Group", Order: 1,
		}},
		Variants: []domain.TaskTestVariant{{
			ID: "variant-id", SourceKey: "variant-key", TaskTestID: "question-id", Text: "Item", Order: 1,
			CorrectOrder: &correctOrder, GroupID: "group-id", GroupSourceKey: "group-key",
		}},
	}}

	public := mapTaskTestResponse(tests, false)
	if len(public[0].Groups) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("classification group labels must remain visible")
	}
	if item := public[0].Variants[0]; item.IsCorrect != nil || item.CorrectOrder != nil || item.GroupID != nil || item.GroupSourceKey != nil {
		t.Fatalf("public response leaked answer key: %+v", item)
	}

	admin := mapTaskTestResponse(tests, true)
	item := admin[0].Variants[0]
	if item.CorrectOrder == nil || *item.CorrectOrder != correctOrder || item.GroupID == nil || *item.GroupID != "group-id" {
		t.Fatalf("admin response omitted answer key: %+v", item)
	}
}

func TestQuizAnswerKeysAreRedactedFromPublicCodeStructure(t *testing.T) {
	raw := json.RawMessage(`{"type":"quiz_theory","quiz":{"expected_answers":["secret"],"ignore_case":true}}`)
	task := &domain.Task{CodeStructure: raw}

	public := buildTaskResponse(task, nil, nil, false, false, nil)
	if string(public.CodeStructure) != `{"quiz":{"ignore_case":true},"type":"quiz_theory"}` {
		t.Fatalf("public response leaked or corrupted quiz contract: %s", public.CodeStructure)
	}

	internal := buildTaskResponse(task, nil, nil, true, true, nil)
	if string(internal.CodeStructure) != string(raw) {
		t.Fatalf("internal response must preserve answer key: %s", internal.CodeStructure)
	}
}

func TestQuizAnswerKeysAreRedactedFromFieldProjection(t *testing.T) {
	item := map[string]any{
		"code_structure": map[string]any{
			"type": "quiz_theory",
			"quiz": map[string]any{"expected_answers": []any{"secret"}, "trim_space": true},
		},
	}

	augmentTaskMap(item)
	quiz := item["code_structure"].(map[string]any)["quiz"].(map[string]any)
	if _, exists := quiz["expected_answers"]; exists {
		t.Fatalf("field projection leaked expected_answers: %+v", item)
	}
	if quiz["trim_space"] != true {
		t.Fatalf("field projection corrupted public quiz settings: %+v", item)
	}
}
